In this task, you will evaluate whether each statement is supported by its corresponding citations. Note
that the system responses may appear very fluent and well-formed, but contain slight inaccuracies that are
not easy to discern at first glance. Pay close attention to the text.

You will be provided with a statement and its corresponding passage which the statement cites. It may be
helpful to ask yourself whether it is accurate to say “according to the citation ...” with the statement following this phrase. Be sure to check all of the information in the statement. You will be given three options:

• Full Support: All of the information in the statement is supported in the citation.
• Partial Support: Some parts of the information are supported in the citation, but other parts are missing.
• No Support: The citation does not support any part of the statement.

Please provide your response based on the information in the citation. If you are unsure, use your best
judgment. Respond as either “Full Support”, “Partial Support”, or “No Support” with no additional
information.
Statement: Seek specialist support through PBS training modules, on‑site professional development, or the “Chasing Butterflies” workshop for more intensive interventions.
Citation: On-Site Training

On-Site Training

On-Site Training

The Institute provides on-site professional development for a wide variety of agencies including child-care providers, Head Start, childcare licensing specialists, child welfare specialists, public school teachers and administrators, Smart Start, parents and extended family. We have developed our professional development packages as well as numerous other trainings that are specifically tailored to meet the needs of different types of organizations.

Creating Effective Learning Environment

Early Learning Guidelines

Theoretical Foundations of Child Development

Topical Workshops

Creating Effective Learning Environment

This is a 20-hour professional development module designed to teach:

The importance of relationship based care

Creating home-like environments for young children, mainly 3 to 5 year olds

This module is helpful to those who are preparing for QRS or accreditation.

Early Learning Guidelines

This is a 16-hour professional development module designed to teach:

The importance of early learning guidelines for children from 3 to 5 years old

Accurate interpretation of the guidelines

Using the early learning guidelines for curriculum development

Documentation of early learning guidelines in lesson plans

This module is adaptable in addressing the early learning guidelines for your state.

Theoretical Foundations of Child Development

This module introduces early childhood professionals to theories of child development and early learning that inform best practices. Topics include:

The importance of early learning guidelines

Accurate interpretation of the guidelines

Using the early learning guidelines for curriculum development

Documentation of early learning guidelines in lesson plans

Behaviorist theory

Accurate interpretation of the guidelines

Attachment theory

Development of Self Regulation

Constructivist theory

Ecological theory

This module can be customized to meet your needs. The complete training is40 hours but it can be condensed to an 8 hour or 16 hour training.

Topical Workshops

The "Institute" has developed a variety of workshops that can be tailored to the needs of different organizations. We can provide overviews of topics as well as more in depth professional development that takes place over longer periods of time.

The Emotional Life of Infants and Toddlers

Learning Environments for Infants and Toddlers

Language Development of Infants and Toddlers

Classroom Guidance and Management

Chasing Butterflies: Challenging Behaviors in the Early Childhood Classroom

Music for Infants and Toddlers

Music in the Early Childhood Classroom

Understanding the Roots of Bullying

Strategies and Solutions for Bullying Behavior

Curriculum Development in the Early Childhood Classroom

Draw Me a Picture, Write Me a Story: Writing with 3-5 Year Olds

Worlds of Discovery: Science in Early Childhood

Math Made Marvelous: Mathematical Thinking in Early Childhood

Prenatal Development and the Impact on Life

Self Regulation: The Lynchpin of Learning

The Impact of Violence on Children

The Impact of Poverty on Children

The Impact of Deployment on Children

The Impact of Toxic Culture on Children

The Foundations of School Readiness

Bookmaking with Children

Reading with Infants and Toddlers

Reading with Preschoolers

Effective Group Times in Early Childhood

The Importance of Play

Creating Home-like Environments

Establishing Routines and Managing Transitions

Ooey-Gooey Messy Stuff

Book Making with School Agers

Minute to Win It with School Agers

Choosing Books to Inspire and Learn

Ages and Stages: Infants and Toddlers

Ages and Stages: Preschoolers

Ages and Stages: School Agers

The Power of Relationships

The Wounded Child: Relationships and Environments that Heal

The Impact of Divorce on Children

This module is adaptable in addressing the early learning guidelines foryour state.
